display_name: Tri-SIG-TIME 源域 AdamW 更新方向诊断
description: 十类和六源各三批次，比较同一 E20 的 L-only 与原保护 L+U 实际首步。
authorization: 用户要求优化 Tri 梯度冲突并详细记录；不改变当前 U 标签权限。

code.environment: N607 ordinary account, existing CVS-RFFI Python, CPU 2, FP32

data.dataset: original ten-class ManyRx and six-source receiver contracts
data.support_query_ref: not applicable; source-only, no target query

permissions.claim_scope: six correlated source snapshots, fresh AdamW moments only

checkpoint.initialization: matching original paper same-setting scratch E20
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: checked at execution: scratch, source-only, same seed and source contract
checkpoint.selection_rule: both original user-requested settings, fixed seed and first three source batches

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, two CPU threads; no GPU workers
execution.stop_rule: Stop diagnostic on identity, role, finite-value, derivative or guard-backward mismatch; do not affect other jobs.

expected_artifacts: two original E20 checkpoint no-query source smokes
six complete source snapshot observations with 12 disposable AdamW steps
per-group L/protected-U gradient and actual incremental/total descent relations

metric_names: L/U gradient norms and dot/cosine before and after guard
L versus AdamW incremental U descent dot/cosine

rows.purpose: compare L-only and guarded L+U actual first-step AdamW
rows.seed_notes: Fixed offsets 0/1/2 use CPU random seeds 2026092701+offset.
rows.scenario: source-only L and U; no target
rows.budget_ref: 6 disposable source batches, 12 disposable parameter-only AdamW steps

notes: U TX truth, V and target are never read; no formal training updates.
Optimizer moments are fresh, so do not infer the rest of the trajectory or target performance.
Source inputs and E20 parents follow original paper roles; selected seed was historically target-exposed.
The experiment is fixed before any new source observation; no candidate training or target prediction.
